items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: We didn't use bass. Drummer? Yeah, it's Crumbie. Alonzo.

ctx.x: And Young Mackie, Red's brother. Dick. Dick. Dick Mackie. That's right. And what was Earl's last name? Earl Crumb. Earl Crumb, yes. Earl Crumb. Oh, yeah. Well, that was a fine outfit. They used to have a nice band.
There were several outstanding orchestras around besides you, is there?
